meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会启动 5 个后台子代理并行审查你的代码：验证目标是否达成、代码质量、安全性、手动运行测试，以及从 GitHub/git/Slack/Notion 挖掘上下文。所有代理必须全部通过，审查才算通过。
howto.when: 当你准备提交 PR 或明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。例如说出“审查我的工作”、“QA 我的工作”、“验证实现”等关键词。

say.note: 启动 5 个代理并行审查当前代码变更。
触发包含手动运行测试的审查流程。
检查代码是否满足原始目标和约束。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude launches 5 parallel background sub-agents to review your code: goal verification, code quality, security, hands-on QA execution, and context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion. All must pass for the review to pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are about to hand off a PR or explicitly ask to review completed work. Say phrases like 'review work', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', etc.

say_en.note: Launches 5 parallel agents to review current code changes.
Triggers a review that includes hands-on app testing.
Checks if the code meets original goals and constraints.
